people.name: Brian Patrick Jack
people.title_or_status: PARTNER, MANAGING DIRECTOR AND CHIEF COMPLIANCE OFFICER
people.bio_note: Partner, Managing Director and Chief Compliance Officer of Pinnacle Peak; over 22 years of financial markets experience. firm_note.text: Pinnacle Peak Private Client Group, LLC, founded in 2016 and based in Scottsdale, provides portfolio management and financial planning to high-net-worth individuals, families, business owners, trusts, and charitable organizations, with a particular focus on active and retired federal employees. IMPORTANT: in a deal announced March 2026, the firm ($460M AUM) joined Ashton Thomas Private Wealth (part of Arax Investment Partners/RedBird Capital) — this firm is likely no longer operating independently and may not be a viable acquisition target.
